resources.string: A few minutes for you. Answer some short questions about your mood, worries, sleep and stress, and see where support can help.
22 short questions, one at a time
Your answers stay on this phone and are not saved
It points you to the right support, it does not label you
Your answers suggest you\'re doing okay right now. Keep up what helps you, like good sleep, time with friends and breaks from studying. If things ever change, we\'re here.
It looks like you might be carrying a bit more than usual lately. That\'s really common at uni, and talking to someone can make a real difference. Student counselling is free and confidential.
It sounds like things have been heavy for you lately, and you deserve support. Please book a chat with student counselling soon. You don\'t have to wait until things get worse.
How you\'re doing in each area
This is a quick check-in, not a diagnosis, so it can\'t know everything about you. If something feels off, a counsellor is always happy to talk, whatever your result.
One of your answers tells us you may be having thoughts of hurting yourself. You don\'t have to carry that alone. Someone is ready to listen right now, any time of day or night.
You do not have to deal with things alone. Tap an option to see how to reach it.
